content.short: AlphaPing runs mandate-driven, non-custodial onchain credit vaults with defined risk boundaries.
content.description: AlphaPing operates credit vaults on Hyperliquid under explicit mandates, so the boundaries of what the vault may do are stated in advance and verifiable on-chain rather than described in a document. Mandate discipline is what institutional allocators expect, and it is one of the clearer advantages on-chain vaults hold over conventional funds.
